hero.title: What Is Included on a Princess Cruise and What Costs Extra?
hero.subtitle: A complete guide to standard cruise fare inclusions, Princess Plus, Princess Premier, extra onboard expenses, and choosing the right fare structure.

introSection.heading: Understanding Princess Cruise Inclusions
introSection.p1: A Princess Cruises vacation includes more than your stateroom and transportation between destinations. Your standard cruise fare generally covers main dining, buffet meals, entertainment, onboard activities, and access to many ship facilities. However, drinks, Wi-Fi, specialty dining, shore excursions, and selected services may cost extra unless they are included in a package or promotion.
introSection.p2: Understanding the difference between the standard fare, Princess Plus, and Princess Premier can help you plan your budget and avoid unexpected onboard expenses.
introSection.p3: This guide explains what is included on a Princess cruise, what you may need to pay for separately, and how to decide whether an upgraded package is worthwhile.

standardInclusions.title: What Is Included in a Standard Princess Cruise Fare?
standardInclusions.subtitle: Core vacation amenities and services covered under every standard Princess ticket

features.title: 1. Your Stateroom Accommodation
features.description: Your booked accommodation is included for the duration of the cruise—from interior staterooms to expansive suites. Your category determines living space, balcony access, and category-specific amenities, while sharing access to the ship's main public spaces and entertainment.

features.title: 2. Main Dining and Buffet Meals
features.description: Multi-course breakfasts, lunches, and dinners in the main dining rooms, 24-hour buffet dining at World Fresh Marketplace, and selected casual options such as poolside pizza, gourmet burgers, soft-serve ice cream, and specialty pastries.

features.title: 3. Entertainment and Live Shows
features.description: Broadway-style theater productions, guest vocalists and comedians, live lounge bands, Movies Under the Stars outdoor giant-screen cinema, game shows, and enrichment lectures.

features.title: 4. Pools and Public Ship Facilities
features.description: Full access to freshwater swimming pools, hot tubs, whirlpools, multi-level sun decks, observation lounges, and outdoor sports courts.

features.title: 5. Fitness Facilities
features.description: Access to the ship's panoramic ocean-view gym, cardio machines, free weights, resistance equipment, and open jogging track during operating hours.

features.title: 6. Youth and Teen Clubs (Camp Discovery)
features.description: Complimentary supervised age-tailored youth and teen clubs created in partnership with Discovery, featuring The Treehouse (ages 3–7), The Lodge (ages 8–12), and The Beach House (teens 13–17).

features.title: 7. MedallionClass Touchless Experience
features.description: The wearable OceanMedallion device provides keyless stateroom access as you approach, touchless embarkation, onboard interactive touchscreens, and ship navigation.

extraExpenses.title: What Is Not Included in a Standard Princess Cruise Fare?
extraExpenses.subtitle: Common out-of-pocket expenses to account for when sailing on a standard fare

items.description: Cocktails, spirits, fine wines by the glass, beer, specialty coffees (espresso, cappuccino), artisan teas, and premium bottled water carry individual charges.
MedallionNet satellite internet access requires a separate daily or voyage package if traveling on a standard cruise fare.
Premium dining venues such as Crown Grill, Sabatini's Italian Trattoria, The Catch by Rudi, and Chef's Table carry cover charges or à la carte pricing.
Organized port tours, wildlife expeditions, glacier flightseeing, and private guided cultural visits are booked separately.
Lotus Spa massages, facials, acupuncture, thermal suite access (The Enclave), salon hair styling, and private cabana access at The Sanctuary.
Self-service laundromat tokens, full-service laundry, pressing, and dry-cleaning services.
Casino gaming, duty-free boutique merchandise, fine art auctions, and professional formal portrait photos.
Airfare to the embarkation port, airport-to-ship shuttles, pre- or post-cruise hotel accommodations, travel insurance, and visas.

fareComparison.title: Princess Standard vs. Princess Plus vs. Princess Premier
fareComparison.subtitle: A side-by-side comparison of Princess Cruises' three fare tiers

plus.title: Princess Plus Package
plus.cost: $70 per person, per day ($75 on Sun & Star Princess)
plus.description: Princess Plus bundles the most popular onboard amenities into one convenient daily rate for effortless budget predictability.
bullets: Plus Beverage Package: cocktails, wine, beer, specialty coffees, and bottled water up to $15 each (subject to package daily limits)
MedallionNet Max Wi-Fi: high-speed satellite internet for 1 device per guest
Crew appreciation / gratuities paid on behalf of eligible guests
4 qualifying casual dining meals per guest per voyage (Alfredo's Pizzeria, Ocean Terrace, etc.)
OceanNow delivery access fee waived & complimentary room-service delivery

premier.title: Princess Premier Package
premier.cost: $105 per person, per day ($110 on Sun & Star Princess)
premier.description: Princess Premier is the most comprehensive package, offering top-tier dining, multi-device connectivity, shore excursion credits, and VIP theater access.
bullets: Premier Beverage Package: top-shelf spirits, premium wines, and craft cocktails up to $20 each with no daily alcoholic drink limit
MedallionNet Max Wi-Fi: multi-device connectivity for up to 4 devices per guest
Crew appreciation / gratuities paid on behalf of eligible guests
Unlimited qualifying specialty dining meals (Crown Grill, Sabatini's, The Catch, etc.)
Unlimited qualifying casual dining meals throughout the voyage
Shore excursion credit: $100 (6–9 days), $200 (10–20 days), or $300 (21+ days)
Photo package: unlimited digital downloads of professional portraits plus 3 printed photos
Reserved theater seating for production shows in the Princess Theater
OceanNow delivery access fee waived & complimentary room-service delivery

fareDecision.title: How to Decide Which Princess Fare Is Right for You
fareDecision.subtitle: Match your personal vacation preferences with the ideal fare tier

options.title: Choose Standard Fare
options.description: Ideal if you drink little alcohol, prefer unplugging without Wi-Fi, and are satisfied with the excellent complimentary dining rooms and buffets.
criteria: You prefer to keep your upfront vacation investment as low as possible
You do not require regular internet access while at sea
You drink few or no alcoholic or specialty beverages
You are completely happy with included main dining room and buffet venues
You prefer paying strictly for the specific extras you actually consume

options.title: Choose Princess Plus
options.description: The sweet spot for travelers wanting daily cocktails, specialty coffee, reliable single-device Wi-Fi, and prepaid gratuities without worrying about a final bill.
criteria: You regularly order cocktails, wine, beer, or morning specialty lattes
You need reliable Wi-Fi for one phone or tablet
You appreciate having daily crew gratuities pre-paid and covered
Four casual sit-down lunches or dinners add value to your sea days
You value peace of mind and budget predictability throughout your cruise

options.title: Choose Princess Premier
options.description: The premier choice for culinary enthusiasts, multiple device users, photo collectors, and guests who want the broadest suite of bundled privileges.
criteria: You plan to dine at specialty restaurants multiple times or every evening
You want multi-device Wi-Fi for smartphones, laptops, and tablets
You enjoy top-shelf liquors, craft cocktails, and premium wines up to $20
You value commemorative professional portraits and digital cruise photos
You want to utilize shore excursion credits and reserved theater seating

faqs.question: What is included in a standard Princess cruise fare?
faqs.answer: A standard Princess cruise fare generally includes your booked stateroom, main dining room meals, buffet and selected casual dining, main entertainment, onboard activities, access to pools and public facilities, and standard fitness facilities. Specific offerings vary by ship and sailing.

faqs.question: Are meals included on Princess Cruises?
faqs.answer: Yes. Main dining room meals, buffet meals, and selected casual dining options are generally included. Specialty restaurants and certain premium dining experiences may cost extra.

faqs.question: Are drinks included on Princess Cruises?
faqs.answer: Some basic beverages are included, but alcoholic drinks, specialty coffees, and many premium beverages generally cost extra unless covered by Princess Plus, Princess Premier, or another eligible offer.

faqs.question: Is Wi-Fi included on Princess Cruises?
faqs.answer: Wi-Fi is not generally included in the standard fare. Princess Plus includes MedallionNet Max for one device per guest, while Princess Premier includes up to four devices per guest, subject to package terms.

faqs.question: Are gratuities included on Princess Cruises?
faqs.answer: Crew appreciation is generally charged separately on standard bookings. Eligible Princess Plus and Princess Premier packages include crew appreciation paid on behalf of guests under the applicable terms.

faqs.question: Is specialty dining included on Princess Cruises?
faqs.answer: Specialty dining is generally an additional purchase with the standard fare. Princess Premier currently includes unlimited qualifying specialty dining meals. Princess Plus includes qualifying casual dining meals, not a general specialty dining allowance.

faqs.question: Are shore excursions free on Princess Cruises?
faqs.answer: No. Most shore excursions are additional purchases. Princess Premier provides eligible excursion credit based on voyage length, subject to the package terms and availability.

faqs.question: Does Princess Plus include unlimited drinks?
faqs.answer: No. Princess Plus covers eligible beverages up to $15 each and is subject to the beverage package's daily alcoholic-drink limit and other conditions.

faqs.question: Does Princess Premier include unlimited drinks?
faqs.answer: Princess Premier covers eligible beverages up to $20 each. Under the current package terms, there is no daily limit on included alcoholic beverages, although exclusions and other beverage rules apply.

faqs.question: Is room service free on Princess Cruises?
faqs.answer: Room-service availability and charges depend on the order and booking. Princess Plus and Princess Premier include room-service delivery under their current terms, but individual food or beverage items may still have conditions or charges.

faqs.question: Is laundry included on Princess Cruises?
faqs.answer: Laundry and dry-cleaning services are generally charged separately unless a specific booking benefit or promotion provides an allowance.

faqs.question: Is Princess Cruises fully all-inclusive?
faqs.answer: No. The standard fare includes many core cruise experiences, but several services remain optional purchases. Princess Plus and Princess Premier bundle additional benefits, but they do not cover every possible travel or onboard expense.
